description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a login screen UI, including layout, styling, and simulated interactions via SnackBars. It includes classes for the main screen widget, theme tokens, and auxiliary UI components.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the login screen UI, with layout and interaction logic.

classes.name: _LoginTokens
classes.description: A utility class holding color tokens used throughout the UI for consistent styling.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class for LoginScreen managing input controllers, UI state, and build method.

classes.name: _DarkFieldContainer
classes.description: A styled container to encapsulate input fields with dark background and border.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Overrides StatefulWidget method to create an instance of _LoginScreenState.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text controllers when the widget is removed from widget tree.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Handles back navigation via Navigator.pop if possible.

methods.name: handleLoginTap
methods.description: Simulates login submission by showing a SnackBar with entered info.

methods.name: handleSocialTap
methods.description: Simulates social login button taps, showing a SnackBar.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI layout of the login screen with Positioned elements.

methods.name: _buildTitle
methods.description: Builds the 'Login' title text positioned near the top.

methods.name: _buildBackButton
methods.description: Builds the back button at the top-left.

methods.name: _buildPasswordField
methods.description: Builds the password input field with visibility toggle.

methods.name: _buildGoogleButton
methods.description: Builds the Google social login button.

methods.name: _buildAppleButton
methods.description: Builds the Apple social login button.

methods.name: _buildFooterRegister
methods.description: Builds the footer text for registration.

methods.name: _buildBottomDragBar
methods.description: Builds a decorative bottom drag bar.

methods.name: _DarkFieldContainer
methods.description: A styled container for input fields with dark background and border.
